description: Vickers 757 Viscount, c/n 219, one of 51 bought by Trans-Canada Air Lines and flown 1955-1974. Moved from Teulon to Garland in 1982 by farmer Don Fyk with wings and engines removed, then reassembled and converted into a summer cottage with a living room, galley kitchen and bedroom. It sits on the main street and is visible from the road, but it is private property.
